Solution: Add the vector component by component: (-5 + (-2), 6 + (1)) = (-7, 7).

Question Choices: What translation reverses the rule (x, y) -> (x + 8, y - 3)?
Hints: Undo each coordinate change.|Use the opposite vector <-8 3>.
Solution: Negate the vector <8, -3> to get <-8, 3>. The inverse rule is (x, y) -> (x - 8, y + 3). Composing the changes gives <0, 0>.
